ipa.curves.zc_curves.ZcCurveDefinitions

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.zc_curves.ZcCurveDefinitions.

Syntax

ZcCurveDefinitions(
    *,
    index_name: OptStr = None,
    index_tenors: OptStrings = None,
    main_constituent_asset_class: AssetClass | None = None,
    pivot_curve_definition: ZcCurveDefinition | None = None,
    reference_curve_definition: ZcCurveDefinition | None = None,
    risk_type: RiskType | None = None,
    currency: OptStr = None,
    discounting_tenor: OptStr = None,
    id: OptStr = None,
    name: OptStr = None,
    source: OptStr = None,
    constituent_override_mode: ConstituentOverrideMode | None = None,
    cross_currency_definitions: Iterable[CrossCurrencyCurveDefinitionPricing] | None = None,
    curve_tenors: OptStrings = None,
    ignore_existing_definition: OptBool = None,
    is_non_deliverable: OptBool = None,
    market_data_location: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
index_name OptStr No None
index_tenors OptStrings No None Defines expected rate surface tenor/slices Defaults to the tenors available, based on provided market data
main_constituent_asset_class AssetClass | None No None
pivot_curve_definition ZcCurveDefinition | None No None
reference_curve_definition ZcCurveDefinition | None No None
risk_type RiskType | None No None
currency OptStr No None The currency code of the interest rate curve
discounting_tenor OptStr No None Mono currency discounting tenor
id OptStr No None Id of the curve definition
name OptStr No None The name of the interest rate curve
source OptStr No None
constituent_override_mode ConstituentOverrideMode | None No None The possible values are:
* replacedefinition: replace the default constituents by the user
constituents from the input request,
* mergewithdefinition: merge the default constituents and the user
constituents from the input request, the default value is 'replacedefinition'.
If the ignore_existing_definition is true, the constituent_override_mode
is set to 'replacedefinition'.
cross_currency_definitions Iterable[CrossCurrencyCurveDefinitionPricing] | None No None The list of the cross currency definition attributes used for pricing the adjusted interest rate curve. if not set in the request the definition matching the currencies, index names and the isnondeliverable flag are retrieved.
curve_tenors OptStrings No None The list of user-defined tenors or dates for which curvepoints to be computed.
The values are expressed in:
* time period code for tenors (e.g., '1m', '6m', '4y'),
* iso 8601 format 'yyyy-mm-dd' for dates (e.g., '2021-01-01').
ignore_existing_definition OptBool No None An indicator whether default definitions are used to get curve parameters and
constituents.
The possible values are:
* True: default definitions are not used (definitions and constituents must
be set in the request),
* False: default definitions are used.
is_non_deliverable OptBool No None An indicator whether the instrument is non-deliverable.
The possible values are:
* True: the instrument is non-deliverable,
* False: the instrument is not non-deliverable.
This parameter may be used to specify the use of crosscurrencydefinitions made
of non-deliverable or deliverable instruments. When this parameters isn't
specified, the default crosscurrencydefinitions is used. this definition with
'isfallbackforfxcurvedefinition'=True is returned by the
crosscurrencydefinitions curve search.
market_data_location OptStr No None
